en: Allows the user to temporarily see demonic shades within Felwood.

Combine three Fel-Touched Flowers into a potion that will temporarily show demonic shades.
Perverse energy emanates weakly from the once-beautiful flower.
Commonly used by crusaders to ward off bad luck. Conveniently, it also useful for cooking.
A highly regulated commodity; buying or selling directly would be unwise. Coveted by chefs when cooking feasts.
Teaches you how to cook Carrie Hearthfire's most desirable feast recipes.
Blessed be the arrow that smites our enemies.
Teaches you how to craft Crusader's Knapsack.
Teaches you how to craft Crimson Dawnwoven Bag.
This document is written in a sloppy shorthand but what you are able to understand suggest that these plans and project notes are the product of a true genius of a craftman.
Teaches you how to craft Pop-Up Shrub.
Incredibly convincing in the context of an opera or a play.
You can only imagine the satisfaction of writing your own signature with this.
A list of items hastily scribbled down whenever it crossed the author's mind.
Contains the collected thoughts and works of Franclorn Forgewright.
A dense leather strap with a heavy steel buckle. Truly a masterpiece of a belt, ready to be ruined by reckless tinkering.
Use the device at a designated triangulation point to aid Fizzlefuse in his teleporter's calibration.
